lastCompletedStory.title: Migrate check-coverage.ts and validate-agents-md.ts spawn call sites to Bun.spawnSync

nextStoryContext: US-002 (this story) migrated the 3 remaining internal git/bun-test spawn adapters (check-coverage.ts's makeDefaultGetCoverage, validate-agents-md.ts's makeGetTrackedFiles and makeIsIgnored) from node:child_process to Bun.spawnSync, with NO exported-type change (all three keep their existing public return signatures). Key finding: node's `.error !== undefined` (spawn failure, e.g. missing git binary) has NO Bun equivalent to port -- Bun.spawnSync throws synchronously (ENOENT) on a missing binary, so that fail-closed guard is now satisfied for free by letting the throw propagate uncaught; do not try to reintroduce an `.error` check. Default stdout/stderr (no stdio/encoding option) are typed Buffer unconditionally (never undefined); decode with `new TextDecoder().decode(result.stdout)`. makeIsIgnored's exit-code mapping (0/1/other-with-stderr-check) ported 1:1 from `.status` to `.exitCode`. This closes out the check-all.ts (US-001) + check-coverage/validate-agents-md (US-002) spawn migration set for the CAM-308 PRD; grep the repo for any remaining `node:child_process` import before assuming there are more in-scope call sites for a future story in this epic.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Docs confirm default stdout/stderr are Buffer instances (not string/undefined) when no encoding/stdio option is passed, and exitCode/success reflect exit status. Docs don't explicitly cover the missing-binary case; empirically verified (real Bun.spawnSync(['nonexistent-binary-xyz']) call) that it throws synchronously with an 'Executable not found in $PATH' Error rather than setting an .error field like node's spawnSync -- implementation relies on this throw for fail-closed semantics.
